Introducing the AI Security Fabric 
Unleash AI Innovators Securely 

A new autonomous defense architecture designed for an era where code creation has accelerated beyond human capacity. Weave an invisible, intelligent layer of defense into every creation. 
Explore the platform 

Play Video: Snyk AI Security Fabric 

You're shipping risk at record speeds 
AI-driven development has put code velocity into overdrive, but 48% of AI-gen code is insecure. Speed without security means insecure code is being introduced faster than ever before.

Attackers are accelerating 
Time-to-exploit (TTE) is shrinking fast. AI-enabled attackers are exploiting vulnerabilities across traditional and emerging attack surfaces, and TTE is expected to accelerate by 50% by 2027. 

Your AI features are now attack vectors 
AI-native components are being embedded into applications everywhere. Pair that with existing vulnerabilities, and attackers can exploit the access and power of AI itself — compounding risk in ways we've never seen.

The Snyk AI Security Platform 

Snyk’s AI-native and agentic platform helps organizations secure and govern development to unleash productivity, reduce business risk, and accelerate software delivery for the age of AI.
